status: Consolidated field-source and header-opening proposal awaiting user agreement; no runtime/cutover.
userRequest: OK, let's look at the final priority table. Which source should Bella use for each field, and when should it open a media header? Keep it simple.
scope: Source selection/opening only. Existing parser fields/formats/text/damage/owner rules and native audio preservation remain. No new binary/media/implementation audit.

existingConstraints.physicalInventory: All supported physical files retained; filename/path/size/DateCreated are filesystem facts.
existingConstraints.FrameRate: Usable own MDB first; eligible already-read header only if MDB rate unusable; no rate-only open.
existingConstraints.Duration: Coherent own MDB first. Agreed MXF fallback only when file MDB metadata unavailable; no isolated timing repair or mixed count/rate/DF; PMR absence alone does not displace usable MDB timing.
existingConstraints.Compression: Eligible already-read MXF/OMF precedes MDB under preservation; no opening reason. WAVE/AIFF unchanged.
existingConstraints.OriginalBin: Same selected master MDB; MXF contributes none; agreed OMF route if alreadyread.
existingConstraints.identityAndMaster: Full normalized qualified IDs; explicit PMR master not silently replaced when unresolved; no unrelated-master filling.
existingConstraints.effects: One combined lookup from final selected confirmedPrecompute Type/ClipName; Sequence excluded.
existingConstraints.nativeAudio: Current WAVE/AIFF native/embedded behaviour preserved and separate OMF rules respected; no FVER gate.

proposedNewChoices.Project: Usable associated PMR then MDB then eligible already-read header; preserve local owner/key rules.
proposedNewChoices.generalFields: MDB then eligible already-read header, with Compression/Duration exceptions, coherent ownership and field-specific availability/conflicts.
proposedNewChoices.identification: PMR physical map/fullFileMobId first; qualified already-required header ID can establish compatible existing MDB match. Master selection follows agreed explicit PMR/unique MDB/eligible header rules.
proposedNewChoices.headerOpen: Once when no usable PMRmap/FileMobId identifies file OR no safely matched MDBfile/required descriptor. No individual blank/master/optional-value trigger or extra PMR modification/staleness gate.
proposedNewChoices.rejoin: If header identifies file, query already-loaded MDB with full ID and apply table; no per-column header/db rereads.
proposedNewChoices.DurationExtension: Propose same coherent MDB-first/database-unavailable header fallback boundary for OMF and preserved WAVE/AIFF result; this cross-source extension is not an old approval.
proposedNewChoices.coherence: Same qualified file/master; one timing bundle; source-qualified geometry/coding/depth inputs. No voting/candidate history/completion-order wins/new identity-conflict UI.

proposedTableMarkdown: | Filename, File Path, Size, Date Created, volume/location | Physical filesystem | Leave unavailable physical facts unavailable; do not substitute recorded source paths/dates. |

| FileMobId | Usable full PMR ID for initial physical-file matching | If a header is required, its qualified full own-file ID can establish the MDB match. All combined facts must match that identity. No eight-byte shortcuts. |

| MasterMobId | Supplied usable PMR master, resolved under the agreed association rules | With no supplied usable master, the uniquely qualified MDB master; then an eligible already-read header association. Do not silently replace an unresolved explicit master. |
| Project | Usable associated PMR Project | MDB Project; then eligible Project from an already-read header. Each parser keeps its own approved local owner/key order. |
| Clip Name | Selected master's usable MDB name | Same selected master's eligible name from an already-read header; otherwise blank. |
| Original Bin | Selected master's usable MDB bin name | Same selected master's eligible OMF/embedded-OMF bin name if already read; otherwise blank. MXF supplies no Original Bin. |
| Kind | Usable own MDB descriptor result | Eligible own-file result from an already-read header; otherwise agreed unknown presentation. |

| Compression | Eligible usable own-file result from an already-read MXF/OMF header, preserving the existing source preference | Usable MDB result when no eligible header result is already available. Preserve current WAVE/AIFF handling, names and agreed fixes. Never open solely for Compression. |
| Resolution | Usable own MDB result | Eligible own-file result from an already-read header; otherwise blank. |
| Video Frame Rate | Usable own MDB descriptor rate | Usable own-file rate only from an independently already-read header; otherwise blank. Audio's Frame Rate stays blank. |
| Audio Sample Rate | Usable own MDB audio rate | Eligible own-file rate from an already-read header; otherwise blank. Video's Sample Rate stays blank. |
| Bit Depth | Usable own MDB interpreted precision/format | Eligible own-file result from an already-read header; otherwise blank. |

| Duration | Usable coherent own MDB timing | Coherent own header timing only when the file's MDB metadata is unavailable and the scan takes the header fallback. An isolated bad/missing MDB Duration does not itself enable this fallback. Otherwise blank. |
| Type | Selected master's usable MDB classification | Same selected master's eligible classification from an already-read header; otherwise blank. |
| Precompute Category | Selected master's usable MDB category | Same selected master's eligible category from an already-read header; otherwise its agreed blank. |

| Effect and Effect Category | One existing combined lookup on final selected Precompute Type and Clip Name | Preserve canonical/custom/unknown rules. No independent source search or header opening. Effect Sequence stays excluded. |

| KelpieId and inventory/status flags | App derivation from physical inventory, qualified IDs and database checks | No extra metadata search solely for flags; an unreadable/incomplete reference check does not prove No Reference. |
